sentences.text:
Sahabzada Singh And Another vs State Of U.P. on 20 January,
2023
Author: Dinesh Kumar Singh

Bench: Dinesh Kumar Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 87
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 50692 of 2022
Applicant :- Sahabzada Singh And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajay Singh,Trivikram Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material on record.
2.

The present bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by
the applicants, Sahabzada Singh and Samiullah Ansari seeking bail in Fir registered at Case Crime
No. 141 of 1996, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 477A, 120-B I.P.C. & Section 13(1)(D) r/w.
13(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, Police Station Baghauch Ghat, District Deoria.

3. The accused-applicants were working as Assistant Teachers and were Class Teachers in Mahant
Triveni Pandit Inter College, Vishnupura Bazar, District Deoria (hereinafter referred to as 'the
College').

entities.text: Sahabzada Singh And Another vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Allegation against the accused-applicants is that in session 1983-84, as per the Government Policy, students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category were given scholarship.

Said college received Rs.1,09,674.00/- amount from the Scheduled Castes Social Welfare Officer, Deoria of Government of Uttar Pradesh for distribution of scholarship among the students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes Social Welfare Officer, Deoria
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On inquiry, it was found that aforesaid amount was received on the basis of the forged and fabricated data of the Scheduled Caste candidates in the college, studying in Class-XI and XII.

The allegation against the accused-applicant is that they being the Class Teachers supplied forged data to receive more amount for embezzlement, and the said amount was embezzled by the accused-applicants and Principal of the college in furtherance of criminal conspiracy.
5. The offence is of year 1982-83.

The accused-applicants are retired and aged around 70 years and they have been in jail since 07.07.2022.
6.
Considering the long incarceration of the accused-applicants in jail pending trial, I find it to be a fit case to enlarge the accused-applicants on bail.

7. Let applicants Sahabzada Singh and Samiullah Ansari be released on bail in the aforesaid case on their furnishing a personal bond and two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions :-
(i) The applicants shall file an undertaking to the effect that they shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(ii) The applicants shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed,
either personally or through their counsel.
In case of their absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against them under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicants misuse the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure their presence, proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicants fail to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against them, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicants shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C. If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicants is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against them in accordance with law.

5. The offence is of year 1982-83.
The accused-applicants are retired and aged around 70 years and they have been in jail since 07.07.2022.
6.
